hash_policy: SHA-256 over UTF-8 JSON serialization of the cases array with sort_keys=true, ensure_ascii=false, and separators=(',', ':'). The digest protects labels, goals, ordering, states, and expected actions.
review_policy: This is a sealed zero-shot holdout. It may not be used for prompt, catalog, alias, route, scoring, or code tuning. Expected answers stay hidden from development feedback. Any content change requires two independent human reviewers, a written rationale, a dataset version bump, and a newly recorded cases_sha256; silent relabeling is forbidden.
blind_evaluation_policy: Evaluate only in a designated blind run. Do not expose case-level outcomes to an optimizer and do not modify production behavior from this artifact's answers. After unsealing for analysis, retire this version from future zero-shot claims and create a separately reviewed successor.
design_dimensions: toolbar icons described only by content_description
drawers, sheets, grids, long lists, dialogs, and full-screen gates
disabled, invisible, selected, checked, and scrollable elements
advertisement, recommendation, search, guest, and duplicate-label decoys
explicit stop boundaries before destructive or state-changing actions
